data_window: 2026-08-23 00:00 to 2026-08-26 22:35 Asia/Shanghai. GitHub Search API queries covered `ai agent`, `mcp agent`, `browser agent`, `code agent`, `RAG agent`, `voice agent`, `AI assistant`, `copilot agent`, `AI workflow`, `LLM app`, and `automation agent` with created/pushed windows and sort=stars/updated. Raw responses were saved under `/tmp/radar_2026_08_26_*.json`; selected README audits were saved under `/tmp/radar_2026_08_26_readmes/`.
source_summary: git fetch origin succeeded on `main...origin/main`; pre-existing unrelated frontend/deploy worktree changes and the old untracked `data/runs/2026-08-19-lark-message.md` were preserved unstaged. Discovery used unauthenticated GitHub Search API metadata plus selected README raw downloads. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, desktop-tested, mobile-tested, MCP-handshake-tested, credential-tested, provider-tested, payment-tested, security-scanned or deployed.
trend_observations: Today’s strongest cluster is agents gaining operational interfaces: dedicated agent inboxes, logged-in browser control, job/application workflows, restart reconciliation, security fix agents, visual verification, browser/voice/RAG frontends, and transaction-safety layers. README evidence for install paths, demos, Docker/API/MCP surfaces, evaluation receipts, permission boundaries and domain-specific workflow artifacts mattered more than raw stars.
assumptions: Scores are editorial point-in-time rankings based on GitHub Search API metadata, README evidence, visible product surface, install/build cues, documentation completeness, repository freshness and AI-native workflow depth. Stars/forks are unauthenticated API snapshots, not exact growth deltas. README claims were not independently runtime-verified. Mature platforms, generic skill catalogs, pure course/content repos, thin wrappers, generated marketing READMEs and projects without clear runnable surfaces were downgraded or skipped. The 2026-08-25 scheduler wake did not leave a committed run in `data/runs`, so this run advances the public dataset from latest committed run 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-26.
